style: A media plan turned editorial: Fraunces display type on a faint spreadsheet grid, DM Mono cell references, sheet-tab navigation, the headline as a selected range, and a flighting chart whose bars are drawn in week by week while a cell cursor moves over them.

concept.idea: Paid ads are bought from a plan: a sheet with channels down the side and weeks across the top. The site is that sheet set as an editorial page: the specialties are the channel rows, the process titles are the plan's three phases, the services are line items and the fee is the double-ruled total.
concept.signature: The flighting chart: six channel rows across twelve weeks under the three phases; when it comes into view the bars are drawn in row by row, then a cell cursor keeps selecting one week at a time, and pointing at a row holds it there. Captioned illustrative; every bar drawn without JS or with reduced motion.
